instruction: Your goal is to explore statistics related to medication prescriptions. Specifically, you want to know the number of patients who were prescribed a medication recorded exactly as "glucophage". If there are patients prescribed under the exact name 'glucophage', you want to know the number of patients. You want the number of patients reported in words instead of numerals (e.g., 123 patients → one hundred and twenty-three). If no patients are prescribed under the exact name 'glucophage,' you want to ask the same question using its generic name instead.
gold_sql: WITH brand_count AS ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ip.patient_id) AS cnt FROM icupatient ip JOIN prescription p ON ip.unit_id = p.unit_id WHERE p.drug_name = 'glucophage' ), generic_count AS ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ip.patient_id) AS cnt FROM icupatient ip JOIN prescription p ON ip.unit_id = p.unit_id WHERE p.drug_name LIKE '%metformin%' ) SELECT CASE WHEN brand_count.cnt > 0 THEN brand_count.cnt ELSE generic_count.cnt END AS patient_count FROM brand_count, generic_count;

instruction: Your goal is to explore statistics related to medication prescriptions. Specifically, you want to find the average ICU length of stay for sepsis patients who were prescribed a medication recorded exactly as 'tazocin'. When calculating the average length of stay, you want to include only the first ICU admission for each patient where both the sepsis diagnosis and the requested medication prescription occurred. When querying for patients diagnosed with sepsis, you want to include diagnosis names that contain the words 'sepsis' or 'septic', as the diagnosis names may not be standardized. You want the final result in days. You want the result rounded to four decimal places. If no sepsis patients were prescribed medication under the exact name 'tazocin', you want to repeat the same question using medications containing Tazocin's generic and other brand names.
gold_sql: WITH first_sepsis_diagnosis AS ( SELECT c.unit_id, MIN(c.condition_time) AS first_sepsis_time FROM condition c WHERE c.condition_name LIKE '%sepsis%' OR c.condition_name LIKE '%septic%' GROUP BY c.unit_id ), tazocin_exact_admissions AS ( SELECT DISTINCT pr.unit_id FROM prescription pr WHERE pr.drug_name = 'tazocin' ), tazocin_component_admissions AS ( SELECT DISTINCT pr.unit_id FROM prescription pr WHERE pr.drug_name LIKE '%piperacillin%tazobactam%' OR pr.drug_name LIKE '%tazobactam%piperacillin%' OR pr.drug_name LIKE '%zosyn%' ), tazocin_final_admissions AS ( SELECT unit_id FROM tazocin_exact_admissions WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tazocin_exact_admissions) UNION ALL SELECT unit_id FROM tazocin_component_admissions WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tazocin_exact_admissions) ), sepsis_tazocin_stays AS ( SELECT ip.patient_id, ip.unit_id, ip.unit_admit_time, ip.unit_discharge_time, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ip.patient_id ORDER BY ip.unit_admit_time) AS stay_rank FROM icupatient ip JOIN first_sepsis_diagnosis fsd ON ip.unit_id = fsd.unit_id JOIN tazocin_final_admissions t ON ip.unit_id = t.unit_id WHERE ip.unit_admit_time IS NOT NULL AND ip.unit_discharge_time IS NOT NULL ), first_sepsis_stay_with_tazocin AS ( SELECT unit_admit_time, unit_discharge_time FROM sepsis_tazocin_stays WHERE stay_rank = 1 ) SELECT ROUND(AVG(JULIANDAY(unit_discharge_time) - JULIANDAY(unit_admit_time)), 4) AS average_icu_stay_days FROM first_sepsis_stay_with_tazocin;

instruction: Your goal is to explore statistics related to medication prescriptions. Specifically, you want to find the most common diagnosis name received by patients prescribed a medication recorded exactly as 'advil' during the same ICU admission. If multiple diagnosis names occur with the same highest frequency, you want to know all of them. If a patient was prescribed the requested medication multiple times, you want to include only the ICU admission associated with the first prescription in the results. If a patient's ICU admission record contains multiple instances of the same diagnosis name, you want to count it only once in the results. You want the answer to be based on the exact diagnosis name recorded in the database. If no patients were prescribed medication under the exact name 'advil,' you want to repeat the same question using medications containing Advil's generic name or its brand name.
gold_sql: WITH AdvilCheck AS ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS advil_count FROM prescription WHERE drug_name = 'advil' ), FirstPrescription AS ( SELECT ip.patient_id, ip.unit_id, pr.medication_start_time, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY ip.patient_id ORDER BY pr.medication_start_time ) AS rn FROM prescription pr JOIN icupatient ip ON pr.unit_id = ip.unit_id JOIN AdvilCheck ac WHERE (ac.advil_count > 0 AND pr.drug_name = 'advil') OR (ac.advil_count = 0 AND (pr.drug_name LIKE '%ibuprofen%' OR pr.drug_name LIKE '%motrin%')) GROUP BY ip.patient_id, ip.unit_id, pr.medication_start_time ), SelectedICUStays AS ( SELECT patient_id, unit_id FROM FirstPrescription WHERE rn = 1 ), UniqueDiagnoses AS ( SELECT DISTINCT c.unit_id, c.condition_name FROM SelectedICUStays s JOIN condition c ON s.unit_id = c.unit_id ), DiagnosisCounts AS ( SELECT condition_name, COUNT(*) AS diag_count, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rank FROM UniqueDiagnoses GROUP BY condition_name ) SELECT condition_name FROM DiagnosisCounts WHERE rank = 1 ORDER BY rank;

instruction: Your goal is to explore statistics related to medication prescriptions. Specifically, you want to know the percentage of patients diagnosed with anxiety who were prescribed a medication recorded exactly as 'loreev xr' at least once during the same ICU admission. If such patients exist, you want the percentage (%) of patients with an anxiety diagnosis who were prescribed Loreev XR during the same ICU admission. You want the result rounded to four decimal places. If no anxiety patients were prescribed medication under the exact name 'loreev xr,' you want to repeat the same question using medications containing Loreev XR's generic or other brand names.
gold_sql: WITH total_anxiety_patients AS ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ip.patient_id) AS total_count FROM icupatient ip JOIN condition c ON ip.unit_id = c.unit_id WHERE c.condition_name LIKE '%anxiety%' ), loreev_exact_patients AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ip.patient_id FROM icupatient ip JOIN condition c ON ip.unit_id = c.unit_id JOIN prescription pr ON ip.unit_id = pr.unit_id WHERE c.condition_name LIKE '%anxiety%' AND pr.drug_name = 'loreev xr' ), loreev_component_patients AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ip.patient_id FROM icupatient ip JOIN condition c ON ip.unit_id = c.unit_id JOIN prescription pr ON ip.unit_id = pr.unit_id WHERE c.condition_name LIKE '%anxiety%' AND pr.drug_name LIKE '%lorazepam%' ), combined_qualifying_patients AS ( SELECT patient_id FROM loreev_exact_patients WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM loreev_exact_patients) UNION ALL SELECT patient_id FROM loreev_component_patients WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM loreev_exact_patients) ) SELECT ROUND( (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT patient_id) FROM combined_qualifying_patients) * 100.0 / (SELECT total_count FROM total_anxiety_patients), 4 ) AS percentage FROM combined_qualifying_patients LIMIT 1;

instruction: You are assisting with a clinical study evaluating antiplatelet therapy prescribing patterns in female ICU patients with acute myocardial infarction. First, identify female patients diagnosed with acute myocardial infarction (both NSTEMI and STEMI) during any hospital admission. Among these patients, check if any have been prescribed a medication recorded exactly as 'brilinta' during the same hospital admission as their diagnosis. If so, report how many such patients exist. If no patient was prescribed brilinta, broaden the search to include any medication containing ticagrelor, excluding brilinta, and report the count. If neither category yields results, report that no matching patients were found. You want the number of patients reported in words instead of numerals (e.g., 123 patients => one hundred and twenty-three).
gold_sql: WITH AMIAdmissions AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ip.patient_id, ip.hosp_id FROM condition c JOIN icupatient ip ON c.unit_id = ip.unit_id WHERE c.condition_name LIKE '%acute myocardial infarction%' AND ip.gender = 'female' ), BrilintaPatients AS ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT aa.patient_id) AS cnt FROM AMIAdmissions aa JOIN icupatient ip ON aa.patient_id = ip.patient_id AND aa.hosp_id = ip.hosp_id JOIN prescription pr ON ip.unit_id = pr.unit_id WHERE pr.drug_name = 'brilinta' ), TicagrelorPatients AS ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT aa.patient_id) AS cnt FROM AMIAdmissions aa JOIN icupatient ip ON aa.patient_id = ip.patient_id AND aa.hosp_id = ip.hosp_id JOIN prescription pr ON ip.unit_id = pr.unit_id WHERE pr.drug_name LIKE '%ticagrelor%' AND pr.drug_name != 'brilinta' ) SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT cnt FROM BrilintaPatients) > 0 THEN (SELECT cnt FROM BrilintaPatients) WHEN (SELECT cnt FROM TicagrelorPatients) > 0 THEN (SELECT cnt FROM TicagrelorPatients) ELSE NULL END AS answer;

instruction: Your goal is to explore statistics related to medication prescriptions. Specifically, you first want to identify patients diagnosed with anxiety. Then, you want to know the percentage (%) of those patients who subsequently received a medication recorded exactly as "remimazolam" during the same ICU admission. You want the result rounded to four decimal places. If no patients were prescribed "remimazolam," you want the percentage (%) of all anxiety patients who were prescribed a medication in the same drug class as remimazolam after the diagnosis during the same ICU admission.
gold_sql: WITH anxiety_diagnoses AS ( SELECT ip.patient_id, ip.unit_id, MIN(c.condition_time) AS condition_time FROM condition c JOIN icupatient ip ON c.unit_id = ip.unit_id WHERE c.condition_name LIKE '%anxiety%' GROUP BY ip.patient_id, ip.unit_id ), remimazolam_anxiety_patients AS ( SELECT DISTINCT a.patient_id FROM anxiety_diagnoses a JOIN prescription pr ON pr.unit_id = a.unit_id WHERE pr.drug_name = 'remimazolam' AND pr.medication_start_time > a.condition_time ), benzo_anxiety_patients AS ( SELECT DISTINCT a.patient_id FROM anxiety_diagnoses a JOIN prescription pr ON pr.unit_id = a.unit_id WHERE ( pr.drug_name LIKE '%valium%' OR pr.drug_name LIKE '%xanax%' OR pr.drug_name LIKE '%ativan%' OR pr.drug_name LIKE '%lorazepam%' OR pr.drug_name LIKE '%klonopin%' OR pr.drug_name LIKE '%midazolam%' OR pr.drug_name LIKE '%diazepam%' OR pr.drug_name LIKE '%versed%' OR pr.drug_name LIKE '%alprazolam%' OR pr.drug_name LIKE '%clonazepam%' OR pr.drug_name LIKE '%restoril%' OR pr.drug_name LIKE '%remimazolam%' ) AND pr.medication_start_time > a.condition_time AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM remimazolam_anxiety_patients) ), combined_patients AS ( SELECT patient_id FROM remimazolam_anxiety_patients UNION ALL SELECT patient_id FROM benzo_anxiety_patients ) SELECT ROUND( 100.0 * (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT patient_id) FROM combined_patients) / (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT patient_id) FROM anxiety_diagnoses), 4 ) AS percentage;

instruction: You are assisting with a clinical study evaluating antidepressant prescribing patterns in ICU patients diagnosed with depression. First, identify patients diagnosed with depression (including all severity levels) during any ICU admission. Among these patients, check if any have been prescribed a medication recorded exactly as 'fluoxetine' after their depression diagnosis within the same ICU admission. If so, list the patient IDs. If no patient was prescribed fluoxetine, broaden the search to include any other SSRI prescribed after their diagnosis, excluding fluoxetine, and list the patient IDs. If neither category yields results, report that no matching patients were found.
gold_sql: WITH DepressionDiagnoses AS ( SELECT c.unit_id, ip.patient_id, MIN(c.condition_time) AS first_depression_time FROM condition c JOIN icupatient ip ON c.unit_id = ip.unit_id WHERE c.condition_name LIKE '%depression%' GROUP BY c.unit_id, ip.patient_id ), FluoxetinePatients AS ( SELECT DISTINCT dd.patient_id FROM DepressionDiagnoses dd JOIN prescription pr ON pr.unit_id = dd.unit_id WHERE pr.drug_name = 'fluoxetine' AND pr.medication_start_time > dd.first_depression_time ), SSRIPatients AS ( SELECT DISTINCT dd.patient_id FROM DepressionDiagnoses dd JOIN prescription pr ON pr.unit_id = dd.unit_id WHERE ( pr.drug_name LIKE '%citalopram%' OR pr.drug_name LIKE '%sertraline%' OR pr.drug_name LIKE '%escitalopram%' OR pr.drug_name LIKE '%fluvoxamine%' OR pr.drug_name LIKE '%paroxetine%' ) AND pr.drug_name NOT LIKE '%fluoxetine%' AND pr.medication_start_time > dd.first_depression_time ), combined AS ( SELECT patient_id FROM FluoxetinePatients WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM FluoxetinePatients) UNION ALL SELECT patient_id FROM SSRIPatients WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM FluoxetinePatients) ) SELECT patient_id FROM combined ORDER BY patient_id;

instruction: Your goal is to explore statistics related to medication prescriptions. Specifically, you want to check if a medication recorded exactly as 'methylprednisolone' was prescribed to patients diagnosed with rheumatoid arthritis after the diagnosis during the same ICU admission. If found, you want to know the list of exact drug names recorded. If no patients were prescribed a medication under the exact name 'methylprednisolone,' you want to repeat the same question using medications in the same drug class as methylprednisolone. If no medications in that drug class are found either, end the conversation.
gold_sql: WITH ra_units AS ( SELECT ip.unit_id, ip.patient_id, MIN(c.condition_time) AS first_ra_time FROM condition c JOIN icupatient ip ON c.unit_id = ip.unit_id WHERE c.condition_name = 'rheumatoid arthritis' GROUP BY ip.unit_id, ip.patient_id ), methylprednisolone_drugs AS ( SELECT DISTINCT pr.drug_name FROM ra_units ra JOIN prescription pr ON pr.unit_id = ra.unit_id WHERE pr.drug_name = 'methylprednisolone' AND pr.medication_start_time > ra.first_ra_time ), other_corticosteroid_drugs AS ( SELECT DISTINCT pr.drug_name FROM ra_units ra JOIN prescription pr ON pr.unit_id = ra.unit_id WHERE ( pr.drug_name LIKE '%prednisone%' OR pr.drug_name LIKE '%prednisolone%' OR pr.drug_name LIKE '%dexamethasone%' OR pr.drug_name LIKE '%hydrocortisone%' OR pr.drug_name LIKE '%cortisone%' OR pr.drug_name LIKE '%budesonide%' OR pr.drug_name LIKE '%triamcinolone%' OR pr.drug_name LIKE '%betamethasone%' ) AND pr.drug_name NOT LIKE '%methylprednisolone%' AND pr.medication_start_time > ra.first_ra_time ), combined AS ( SELECT drug_name FROM methylprednisolone_drugs WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM methylprednisolone_drugs) UNION ALL SELECT drug_name FROM other_corticosteroid_drugs WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM methylprednisolone_drugs) ) SELECT drug_name FROM combined ORDER BY drug_name;

instruction: Your goal is to analyze beta-blocker prescription patterns in patients with atrial flutter. Specifically, you want to find the percentage of patients diagnosed with various types of atrial flutter who were not prescribed a beta-blocker during the same ICU admission. You want to first check if any of those patients were prescribed a medication recorded exactly as 'sotalol' in the same ICU record. If no patients were prescribed a medication under the exact name 'sotalol,' you want to repeat the same question using medications in the same drug class as sotalol. If a patient has received the diagnosis multiple times, you want to include only the ICU record associated with the first diagnosis in the calculation. You want the result in percentage (%) rounded to four decimal places. If no beta-blockers are found either, end the conversation.
gold_sql: WITH RankedDiagnosis AS ( SELECT ip.patient_id, c.unit_id, c.condition_time, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY ip.patient_id ORDER BY c.condition_time, c.unit_id ) AS rn FROM icupatient ip JOIN condition c ON ip.unit_id = c.unit_id WHERE c.condition_name LIKE '%atrial flutter%' ), FirstAtrialFlutter AS ( SELECT patient_id, unit_id FROM RankedDiagnosis WHERE rn = 1 ), sotalol_patients AS ( SELECT DISTINCT af.patient_id FROM FirstAtrialFlutter af JOIN prescription pr ON af.unit_id = pr.unit_id WHERE pr.drug_name = 'sotalol' ), other_beta_blocker_patients AS ( SELECT DISTINCT af.patient_id FROM FirstAtrialFlutter af JOIN prescription pr ON af.unit_id = pr.unit_id WHERE pr.drug_name LIKE '%atenolol%' OR pr.drug_name LIKE '%carvedilol%' OR pr.drug_name LIKE '%labetalol%' OR pr.drug_name LIKE '%propranolol%' OR pr.drug_name LIKE '%timolol%' OR pr.drug_name LIKE '%metoprolol%' OR pr.drug_name LIKE '%bisoprolol%' OR pr.drug_name LIKE '%nadolol%' OR pr.drug_name LIKE '%nebivolol%' OR pr.drug_name LIKE '%esmolol%' ), total_patients AS ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT patient_id) AS total_count FROM FirstAtrialFlutter ), no_sotalol_count AS ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT af.patient_id) AS cnt FROM FirstAtrialFlutter af LEFT JOIN sotalol_patients sp ON af.patient_id = sp.patient_id WHERE sp.patient_id IS NULL ), no_other_bb_count AS ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT af.patient_id) AS cnt FROM FirstAtrialFlutter af LEFT JOIN other_beta_blocker_patients obp ON af.patient_id = obp.patient_id WHERE obp.patient_id IS NULL ) SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sotalol_patients) THEN ROUND( 100.0 * (SELECT cnt FROM no_sotalol_count) / (SELECT total_count FROM total_patients), 4 ) WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM other_beta_blocker_patients) THEN ROUND( 100.0 * (SELECT cnt FROM no_other_bb_count) / (SELECT total_count FROM total_patients), 4 ) ELSE NULL END AS percentage;

instruction: Your goal is to analyze prescription patterns for heart failure. Specifically, you want to find the percentage of patients diagnosed with heart failure who were prescribed a medication recorded exactly as 'finerenone' during the same ICU visit. If a patient's ICU admission record contains multiple instances of the same condition, you want to count it only once per patient. You want the result in percentage (%) rounded to four decimal places. If no patients were prescribed a medication under the exact name 'finerenone,' you want to repeat the same question using medications in the same drug class as Finerenone. If no mineralocorticoid receptor antagonists are found either, end the conversation.
gold_sql: WITH heart_failure_units AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ip.patient_id, ip.unit_id FROM icupatient ip JOIN condition c ON ip.unit_id = c.unit_id WHERE c.condition_name LIKE '%heart failure%' ), finerenone_hf_patients AS ( SELECT DISTINCT hfu.patient_id FROM heart_failure_units hfu JOIN prescription p ON hfu.unit_id = p.unit_id WHERE p.drug_name = 'finerenone' ), class_hf_patients AS ( SELECT DISTINCT hfu.patient_id FROM heart_failure_units hfu JOIN prescription p ON hfu.unit_id = p.unit_id WHERE (p.drug_name LIKE '%spironolactone%' OR p.drug_name LIKE '%eplerenone%') ), total_hf_patients AS ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT patient_id) AS total_count FROM heart_failure_units ) SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM finerenone_hf_patients) THEN ROUND((SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT patient_id) FROM finerenone_hf_patients) * 100.0 / (SELECT total_count FROM total_hf_patients), 4) WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM class_hf_patients) THEN ROUND((SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT patient_id) FROM class_hf_patients) * 100.0 / (SELECT total_count FROM total_hf_patients), 4) ELSE NULL END AS percentage;

instruction: Your goal is to explore statistics related to medication prescriptions for Peptic Ulcer Disease (PUD). Specifically, you want to check if a medication recorded exactly as 'ranitidine' was prescribed to PUD patients following their first PUD diagnosis during the same ICU admission. If found, you want to know the list of exact drug names recorded. If no patients were prescribed a medication under the exact name 'ranitidine,' you want to repeat the same question using medications in the same drug class as ranitidine (i.e., other H2 receptor antagonists). If no H2 receptor antagonists are found either, end the conversation.
gold_sql: WITH FirstCondition AS ( SELECT ip.patient_id, ip.unit_id AS first_pud_unit_id, MIN(c.condition_time) AS first_condition_time FROM icupatient ip JOIN condition c ON ip.unit_id = c.unit_id WHERE c.condition_name IN ( 'peptic ulcer disease', 'peptic ulcer disease - duodenal' ) GROUP BY ip.patient_id, ip.unit_id ), FirstPUDAdmission AS ( SELECT * FROM FirstCondition WHERE (patient_id, first_condition_time) IN ( SELECT patient_id, MIN(first_condition_time) FROM FirstCondition GROUP BY patient_id ) ), ranitidine_drugs AS ( SELECT DISTINCT pr.drug_name FROM prescription pr JOIN FirstPUDAdmission fpa ON pr.unit_id = fpa.first_pud_unit_id WHERE pr.drug_name = 'ranitidine' AND pr.medication_start_time > fpa.first_condition_time ), other_h2_blocker_drugs AS ( SELECT DISTINCT pr.drug_name FROM prescription pr JOIN FirstPUDAdmission fpa ON pr.unit_id = fpa.first_pud_unit_id WHERE (pr.drug_name LIKE '%famotidine%' OR pr.drug_name LIKE '%cimetidine%' OR pr.drug_name LIKE '%nizatidine%' OR pr.drug_name LIKE '%pepcid%') AND pr.drug_name != 'ranitidine' AND pr.medication_start_time > fpa.first_condition_time ) SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ranitidine_drugs) THEN (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(drug_name, ', ') FROM (SELECT drug_name FROM ranitidine_drugs ORDER BY drug_name)) WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM other_h2_blocker_drugs) THEN (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(drug_name, ', ') FROM (SELECT drug_name FROM other_h2_blocker_drugs ORDER BY drug_name)) ELSE NULL END AS drug_names;

instruction: Your goal is to explore statistics related to medication prescriptions. Specifically, you want to find the percentage of patients who were prescribed a medication recorded exactly as 'apixaban' on 2100-12-31 out of all patients with any prescription on that date. You want the result in percentage (%) rounded to four decimal places. If no patients were prescribed a medication under the exact name 'apixaban,' you want to repeat the same question using medications in the same drug class as apixaban. If no anticoagulants are found either, end the conversation.
gold_sql: WITH apixaban_patients AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ip.patient_id FROM icupatient ip JOIN prescription p ON ip.unit_id = p.unit_id WHERE DATE(p.medication_start_time) = '2100-12-31' AND p.drug_name = 'apixaban' ), other_anticoagulant_patients AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ip.patient_id FROM icupatient ip JOIN prescription p ON ip.unit_id = p.unit_id WHERE DATE(p.medication_start_time) = '2100-12-31' AND (p.drug_name LIKE '%warfarin%' OR p.drug_name LIKE '%coumadin%' OR p.drug_name LIKE '%rivaroxaban%' OR p.drug_name LIKE '%dabigatran%' OR p.drug_name LIKE '%edoxaban%' OR p.drug_name LIKE '%heparin%' OR p.drug_name LIKE '%enoxaparin%' OR p.drug_name LIKE '%fondaparinux%') ), total_patients AS ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ip.patient_id) AS total_count FROM icupatient ip JOIN prescription p ON ip.unit_id = p.unit_id WHERE DATE(p.medication_start_time) = '2100-12-31' ) SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM apixaban_patients) THEN ROUND((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM apixaban_patients) * 100.0 / (SELECT total_count FROM total_patients), 4) WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM other_anticoagulant_patients) THEN ROUND((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM other_anticoagulant_patients) * 100.0 / (SELECT total_count FROM total_patients), 4) ELSE NULL END AS percentage;

instruction: Your goal is to explore statistics related to medication prescriptions. Specifically, you want to identify the three most common diagnosis names received by patients who were prescribed both an ACE inhibitor and a beta-blocker at least once each during the same ICU admission. You want to first check if a medication recorded exactly as 'enalapril' exists in the database as the ACE inhibitor. If no prescription under the exact name 'enalapril' is found, you want to repeat the same question using medications in the same drug class as enalapril. If a patient received simultaneous prescriptions for these medications across multiple ICU admissions, you want to count only the first ICU admission record. If a patient received multiple diagnoses during the same ICU admission, you want to count each diagnosis only once. If multiple diagnosis names occur with the same frequency, you want to know all of them. You want the answer in the exact diagnosis names recorded in the database. If no ACE inhibitors are found either, end the conversation.
gold_sql: WITH enalapril_drugs AS ( SELECT DISTINCT drug_name FROM prescription WHERE drug_name = 'enalapril' ), other_ace_inhibitor_drugs AS ( SELECT DISTINCT drug_name FROM prescription WHERE (drug_name LIKE '%captopril%' OR drug_name LIKE '%lisinopril%' OR drug_name LIKE '%ramipril%' OR drug_name LIKE '%benazepril%' OR drug_name LIKE '%fosinopril%' OR drug_name LIKE '%quinapril%' OR drug_name LIKE '%perindopril%' OR drug_name LIKE '%trandolapril%') ), selected_ace AS ( SELECT drug_name FROM enalapril_drugs WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM enalapril_drugs) UNION ALL SELECT drug_name FROM other_ace_inhibitor_drugs WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM enalapril_drugs) ), beta_blockers AS ( SELECT DISTINCT drug_name FROM prescription WHERE drug_name LIKE '%metoprolol%' OR drug_name LIKE '%atenolol%' OR drug_name LIKE '%propranolol%' OR drug_name LIKE '%carvedilol%' OR drug_name LIKE '%bisoprolol%' OR drug_name LIKE '%nadolol%' OR drug_name LIKE '%timolol%' OR drug_name LIKE '%labetalol%' ), patients_with_both AS ( SELECT ip.patient_id, ip.unit_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ip.patient_id ORDER BY ip.unit_admit_time) AS rn FROM icupatient ip WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM prescription pr WHERE pr.unit_id = ip.unit_id AND pr.drug_name IN (SELECT drug_name FROM selected_ace) ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM prescription pr WHERE pr.unit_id = ip.unit_id AND pr.drug_name IN (SELECT drug_name FROM beta_blockers) ) ), first_icu_stay AS ( SELECT unit_id FROM patients_with_both WHERE rn = 1 ), diagnoses AS ( SELECT DISTINCT f.unit_id, c.condition_name FROM first_icu_stay f JOIN condition c ON f.unit_id = c.unit_id ), diagnosis_counts AS ( SELECT condition_name, COUNT(*) AS diag_count, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rnk FROM diagnoses GROUP BY condition_name ) SELECT CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM selected_ace) THEN NULL WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM first_icu_stay) THEN NULL ELSE (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(condition_name, ', ') FROM (SELECT condition_name FROM diagnosis_counts WHERE rnk <= 3 ORDER BY rnk, condition_name)) END AS top_diagnoses;
gold_answer: acute respiratory failure, hypertension, acute coronary syndrome - acute myocardial infarction (no st elevation), congestive heart failure

instruction: You are assisting with a clinical study evaluating the adoption of direct oral anticoagulants (DOACs) in ICU patients newly diagnosed with atrial fibrillation. First, identify patients diagnosed with atrial fibrillation this month. Among these patients, check if any have been prescribed a DOAC after their atrial fibrillation diagnosis. If so, list the exact medication names as recorded in the database. If no patient was prescribed a DOAC, broaden the search to include any other anticoagulant therapy prescribed after their diagnosis, and list the exact medication names. If neither category yields results, report that no matching prescriptions were found.
gold_sql: WITH AFPatientsThisMonth AS ( SELECT ip.patient_id, ip.unit_id, MIN(c.condition_time) AS first_af_time FROM condition c JOIN icupatient ip ON c.unit_id = ip.unit_id WHERE c.condition_name LIKE '%atrial fibrillation%' AND datetime(c.condition_time, 'start of month') = datetime('2100-12-31 23:59:00', 'start of month') AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM condition c2 JOIN icupatient ip2 ON c2.unit_id = ip2.unit_id WHERE ip2.patient_id = ip.patient_id AND c2.condition_name LIKE '%atrial fibrillation%' AND c2.condition_time < c.condition_time ) GROUP BY ip.patient_id, ip.unit_id ), DOACPrescriptions AS ( SELECT DISTINCT pr.drug_name FROM AFPatientsThisMonth a JOIN prescription pr ON a.unit_id = pr.unit_id WHERE (pr.drug_name LIKE '%apixaban%' OR pr.drug_name LIKE '%rivaroxaban%' OR pr.drug_name LIKE '%dabigatran%' OR pr.drug_name LIKE '%edoxaban%') AND pr.medication_start_time > a.first_af_time ), OtherAnticoagulants AS ( SELECT DISTINCT pr.drug_name FROM AFPatientsThisMonth a JOIN prescription pr ON a.unit_id = pr.unit_id WHERE ( pr.drug_name LIKE '%warfarin%' OR pr.drug_name LIKE '%coumadin%' OR pr.drug_name LIKE '%heparin%' OR pr.drug_name LIKE '%enoxaparin%' OR pr.drug_name LIKE '%fondaparinux%') AND pr.medication_start_time > a.first_af_time ), combined AS ( SELECT drug_name FROM DOACPrescriptions WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM DOACPrescriptions) UNION ALL SELECT drug_name FROM OtherAnticoagulants WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM DOACPrescriptions) ) SELECT drug_name FROM combined ORDER BY drug_name;
gold_answer: 0.4 ml syringe : enoxaparin sodium 40 mg/0.4ml sc soln

instruction: Your goal is to explore patient data related to medication prescriptions. Do not confuse the use of 'and' and 'or' when describing the conditions. All qualifying conditions must be satisfied within the same hospital admission, not limited to the same ICU admission. If the database contains multiple WBC items, you want to use 'wbc x 1000'. If the database lacks records for immature (band) forms, you want to use '-bands'. You do not know how lab results such as 'wbc x 1000', '-bands', or PaCO2 are stored in the database, so do not mention them unless the DB agent mentions them first. For change in mental status, even if multiple related diagnosis names exist, you want to request only the diagnosis name 'change in mental status'. You want the number of patients reported in words instead of numerals (e.g., 123 patients → one hundred and twenty-three).
gold_sql: WITH HospitalStaysThisMonth AS ( SELECT DISTINCT i.patient_id, i.hosp_id FROM icupatient i WHERE datetime(i.hospital_admit_time, 'start of month') = datetime('2100-12-31 23:59:00', 'start of month') ), TemperatureCriterion AS ( SELECT DISTINCT h.patient_id, h.hosp_id FROM HospitalStaysThisMonth h JOIN icupatient i ON h.hosp_id = i.hosp_id JOIN vital_signs v ON i.unit_id = v.unit_id WHERE v.temperature > 38.3 OR v.temperature < 36 ), HeartRateCriterion AS ( SELECT DISTINCT h.patient_id, h.hosp_id FROM HospitalStaysThisMonth h JOIN icupatient i ON h.hosp_id = i.hosp_id JOIN vital_signs v ON i.unit_id = v.unit_id WHERE v.heart_rate > 90 ), RespiratoryCriterion AS ( SELECT DISTINCT h.patient_id, h.hosp_id FROM HospitalStaysThisMonth h JOIN icupatient i ON h.hosp_id = i.hosp_id JOIN vital_signs v ON i.unit_id = v.unit_id WHERE v.respiration_rate > 20 UNION SELECT DISTINCT h.patient_id, h.hosp_id FROM HospitalStaysThisMonth h JOIN icupatient i ON h.hosp_id = i.hosp_id JOIN lab l ON i.unit_id = l.unit_id WHERE l.lab_name = 'paco2' AND l.lab_result < 32 ), WBCCriterion AS ( SELECT DISTINCT h.patient_id, h.hosp_id FROM HospitalStaysThisMonth h JOIN icupatient i ON h.hosp_id = i.hosp_id JOIN lab l ON i.unit_id = l.unit_id WHERE l.lab_name = 'wbc x 1000' AND (l.lab_result > 12 OR l.lab_result < 4) UNION SELECT DISTINCT h.patient_id, h.hosp_id FROM HospitalStaysThisMonth h JOIN icupatient i ON h.hosp_id = i.hosp_id JOIN lab l ON i.unit_id = l.unit_id WHERE l.lab_name = '-bands' AND l.lab_result > 10 ), BloodPressureCriterion AS ( SELECT DISTINCT h.patient_id, h.hosp_id FROM HospitalStaysThisMonth h JOIN icupatient i ON h.hosp_id = i.hosp_id JOIN vital_signs v ON i.unit_id = v.unit_id WHERE v.systolic_bp < 90 OR v.mean_bp < 65 ), MentalStatusCriterion AS ( SELECT DISTINCT h.patient_id, h.hosp_id FROM HospitalStaysThisMonth h JOIN icupatient i ON h.hosp_id = i.hosp_id JOIN condition c ON i.unit_id = c.unit_id WHERE c.condition_name = 'change in mental status' ), ConditionCounts AS ( SELECT h.patient_id, h.hosp_id, (CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TemperatureCriterion t WHERE t.hosp_id = h.hosp_id) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM HeartRateCriterion hr WHERE hr.hosp_id = h.hosp_id) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM RespiratoryCriterion r WHERE r.hosp_id = h.hosp_id) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM WBCCriterion w WHERE w.hosp_id = h.hosp_id) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM BloodPressureCriterion b WHERE b.hosp_id = h.hosp_id) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM MentalStatusCriterion m WHERE m.hosp_id = h.hosp_id) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS condition_count FROM HospitalStaysThisMonth h ), EligiblePatients AS ( SELECT DISTINCT patient_id, hosp_id FROM ConditionCounts WHERE condition_count >= 3 ), EligibleWithDIC AS ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ep.patient_id) AS patient_count FROM EligiblePatients ep JOIN icupatient i ON ep.hosp_id = i.hosp_id JOIN condition c ON i.unit_id = c.unit_id WHERE c.condition_name LIKE '%disseminated intravascular%' ), EligibleWithOtherOrganDysfunction AS ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ep.patient_id) AS patient_count FROM EligiblePatients ep JOIN icupatient i ON ep.hosp_id = i.hosp_id JOIN condition c ON i.unit_id = c.unit_id WHERE (c.condition_name LIKE '%septic shock%' OR c.condition_name LIKE '%acute renal failure%' OR c.condition_name LIKE '%acute kidney%' OR c.condition_name LIKE '%acute respiratory distress%' OR c.condition_name LIKE '%acute respiratory failure%' OR c.condition_name LIKE '%hepatic dysfunction%' OR c.condition_name LIKE '%lactic acidosis%' OR c.condition_name LIKE '%coagulopathy%' OR c.condition_name LIKE '%organ failure%' OR c.condition_name LIKE '%organ dysfunction%') AND c.condition_name NOT LIKE '%disseminated intravascular%' ) SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT patient_count FROM EligibleWithDIC) > 0 THEN (SELECT patient_count FROM EligibleWithDIC) WHEN (SELECT patient_count FROM EligibleWithOtherOrganDysfunction) > 0 THEN (SELECT patient_count FROM EligibleWithOtherOrganDysfunction) ELSE NULL END AS answer;

instruction: Your goal is to find the number of patients who may be eligible for a clinical study on secondary cardiovascular prevention with statin therapy. You want to include patients with records in the database who have at least two of the following cardiovascular risk factors during the same ICU admission: - Condition 1: Hypertension - Condition 2: Type 2 diabetes - Condition 3: Chronic kidney disease - Condition 4: Myocardial infarction or angina - Condition 5: Stroke Among the patients meeting the above criteria, you want to include only those who have been prescribed a medication recorded exactly as 'rosuvastatin' during the same ICU admission. If no patients were prescribed a medication under the exact name 'rosuvastatin,' you want to repeat the same question using medications in the same drug class as rosuvastatin. If still no patients are found, end the conversation. If certain conditions are missing from the database, you may ignore them during the conversation. Do not confuse the use of 'and' and 'or' when describing the conditions. You want different variations of the same diagnosis treated as a single diagnosis (e.g., controlled hypertension and uncontrolled hypertension should be treated as hypertension). You want to identify conditions only when they are the main diagnosis, and exclude diagnosis names that appear only as the cause of another diagnosis. You want the number of patients reported in words instead of numerals (e.g., 123 patients → one hundred and twenty-three).
gold_sql: WITH PatientDiagnoses AS ( SELECT ip.patient_id, ip.unit_id, MAX( CASE WHEN cond.condition_name LIKE '%hypertension%' AND cond.condition_name NOT LIKE '% - due to %' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS has_hypertension, MAX( CASE WHEN ( cond.condition_name LIKE '%diabetes mellitus%type ii%' OR cond.condition_name LIKE '%diabetes mellitus%type 2%' ) AND cond.condition_name NOT LIKE '% - due to %' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS has_diabetes, MAX( CASE WHEN cond.condition_name LIKE '%chronic kidney disease%' AND cond.condition_name NOT LIKE '% - due to %' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS has_ckd, MAX( CASE WHEN ( cond.condition_name LIKE '%myocardial infarction%' OR cond.condition_name LIKE '%angina%' ) AND cond.condition_name NOT LIKE '% - due to %' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS has_heart_condition, MAX( CASE WHEN cond.condition_name LIKE '%stroke%' AND cond.condition_name NOT LIKE '% - due to %' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS has_stroke FROM condition cond JOIN icupatient ip ON cond.unit_id = ip.unit_id GROUP BY ip.patient_id, ip.unit_id ), EligiblePatients AS ( SELECT DISTINCT patient_id, unit_id FROM PatientDiagnoses WHERE (has_hypertension + has_diabetes + has_ckd + has_heart_condition + has_stroke) >= 2 ), RosuvastatinPatients AS ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ep.patient_id) AS cnt FROM EligiblePatients ep JOIN prescription pr ON ep.unit_id = pr.unit_id WHERE pr.drug_name = 'rosuvastatin' ), OtherStatinPatients AS ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ep.patient_id) AS cnt FROM EligiblePatients ep JOIN prescription pr ON ep.unit_id = pr.unit_id WHERE ( pr.drug_name LIKE '%atorvastatin%' OR pr.drug_name LIKE '%simvastatin%' OR pr.drug_name LIKE '%pravastatin%' OR pr.drug_name LIKE '%lovastatin%' OR pr.drug_name LIKE '%fluvastatin%' OR pr.drug_name LIKE '%pitavastatin%' ) AND pr.drug_name NOT LIKE '%rosuvastatin%' ) SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT cnt FROM RosuvastatinPatients) > 0 THEN (SELECT cnt FROM RosuvastatinPatients) WHEN (SELECT cnt FROM OtherStatinPatients) > 0 THEN (SELECT cnt FROM OtherStatinPatients) ELSE NULL END AS answer;

instruction: You are assisting with a clinical study on acute kidney injury (AKI) in ICU patients. The study aims to identify patients who exhibit kidney dysfunction alongside hemodynamic instability, while excluding those with pre-existing chronic kidney conditions. First, identify patients who meet the following inclusion criteria: - Kidney dysfunction, defined as either: (a) serum creatinine > 2.0 mg/dL for males or > 1.8 mg/dL for females, OR (b) 24-hour daily urine output total < 200 mL on any single day - Critical vital signs at the same time point: heart rate > 100 bpm AND systolic blood pressure < 90 mmHg Then, exclude patients with: - Pre-existing chronic kidney disease (including chronic renal insufficiency, ESRD, or end-stage renal disease) - Age under 18 Among the eligible patients, check if any have been diagnosed with hepatorenal syndrome recorded exactly as 'hepatorenal syndrome'. If so, report how many such patients exist. If no eligible patient has hepatorenal syndrome, broaden the search to include any acute renal failure diagnosis (such as acute renal failure, acute kidney injury, or acute tubular necrosis), excluding hepatorenal syndrome, and report the count. If neither category yields results, report that no matching patients were found. Report the final count in words rather than numerals (e.g., 123 → one hundred and twenty-three).
gold_sql: WITH KidneyDysfunction AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ip.patient_id, ip.unit_id FROM lab l JOIN icupatient ip ON l.unit_id = ip.unit_id WHERE l.lab_name = 'creatinine' AND ( (ip.gender = 'male' AND l.lab_result > 2.0) OR (ip.gender = 'female' AND l.lab_result > 1.8)) UNION SELECT ip.patient_id, ip.unit_id FROM fluid_balance fb JOIN icupatient ip ON fb.unit_id = ip.unit_id WHERE fb.fluid_path LIKE '%output%' AND (fb.fluid_label LIKE '%urine%' OR fb.fluid_label LIKE '%foley%') AND fb.fluid_label NOT LIKE '%occurrence%' AND fb.fluid_label NOT LIKE '%count%' GROUP BY ip.patient_id, ip.unit_id, DATE(fb.fluid_balance_time) HAVING SUM(fb.fluid_value_numeric) < 200 ), CriticalVitals AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ip.patient_id, ip.unit_id FROM vital_signs vs JOIN icupatient ip ON vs.unit_id = ip.unit_id WHERE vs.heart_rate > 100 AND vs.systolic_bp < 90 ), InclusionCriteria AS ( SELECT DISTINCT kd.patient_id, kd.unit_id FROM KidneyDysfunction kd JOIN CriticalVitals cv ON kd.unit_id = cv.unit_id ), ExclusionCKD AS ( SELECT ip.patient_id, ip.unit_id FROM condition c JOIN icupatient ip ON c.unit_id = ip.unit_id WHERE c.condition_name LIKE '%chronic kidney disease%' OR c.condition_name LIKE '%chronic renal%' OR c.condition_name LIKE '%esrd%' OR c.condition_name LIKE '%end stage renal%' ), ExclusionAge AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ip.patient_id, ip.unit_id FROM icupatient ip WHERE ip.age < 18 ), EligiblePatients AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ic.patient_id, ic.unit_id FROM InclusionCriteria ic WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ExclusionCKD eckd WHERE eckd.unit_id = ic.unit_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ExclusionAge ea WHERE ea.unit_id = ic.unit_id) ), HepatoRenalPatients AS ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ep.patient_id) AS cnt FROM EligiblePatients ep JOIN condition c ON ep.unit_id = c.unit_id WHERE c.condition_name = 'hepatorenal syndrome' ), AcuteRenalPatients AS ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ep.patient_id) AS cnt FROM EligiblePatients ep JOIN condition c ON ep.unit_id = c.unit_id WHERE ( c.condition_name LIKE '%acute renal failure%' OR c.condition_name LIKE '%acute kidney%' OR c.condition_name LIKE '%acute tubular necrosis%') AND c.condition_name != 'hepatorenal syndrome' ) SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT cnt FROM HepatoRenalPatients) > 0 THEN (SELECT cnt FROM HepatoRenalPatients) WHEN (SELECT cnt FROM AcuteRenalPatients) > 0 THEN (SELECT cnt FROM AcuteRenalPatients) ELSE NULL END AS answer;

instruction: You are assisting with a clinical study evaluating the need for renal replacement therapy (RRT)among ICU patients presenting with concurrent electrolyte disturbances and renal dysfunction. First, identify patients who had all of the following based on lab measurements recorded today during the same ICU admission: 1. At least one electrolyte imbalance: - Serum bicarbonate < 22 mEq/L - Serum sodium < 125 mEq/L or > 150 mEq/L - Serum potassium < 3.5 mEq/L or > 5.5 mEq/L 2. Renal dysfunction: serum creatinine > 1.3 mg/dL for males or > 1.1 mg/dL for females Among these eligible patients, determine how many have received hemodialysis specifically for acute renal failure, recorded exactly as 'hemodialysis - for acute renal failure'. If no eligible patient has this specific treatment, broaden the search to include any hemodialysis treatment and report that count. If neither category yields results, report that no matching patients were found. Report the final count in words rather than numerals (e.g., 123 → one hundred and twenty-three).
gold_sql: WITH ElectrolyteImbalances AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ip.patient_id, l.unit_id FROM lab l JOIN icupatient ip ON l.unit_id = ip.unit_id WHERE datetime(l.lab_result_time, 'start of day') = datetime('2100-12-31 23:59:00', 'start of day') AND ( ( (l.lab_name = 'bicarbonate' OR l.lab_name = 'hco3') AND l.lab_result < 22 ) OR ( l.lab_name = 'sodium' AND (l.lab_result < 125 OR l.lab_result > 150) ) OR ( l.lab_name = 'potassium' AND (l.lab_result < 3.5 OR l.lab_result > 5.5) ) ) ), RenalAbnormalities AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ip.patient_id, l.unit_id FROM lab l JOIN icupatient ip ON l.unit_id = ip.unit_id WHERE datetime(l.lab_result_time, 'start of day') = datetime('2100-12-31 23:59:00', 'start of day') AND l.lab_name = 'creatinine' AND ( (ip.gender = 'male' AND l.lab_result > 1.3) OR (ip.gender = 'female' AND l.lab_result > 1.1) ) ), EligiblePatients AS ( SELECT DISTINCT e.patient_id, e.unit_id FROM ElectrolyteImbalances e JOIN RenalAbnormalities r ON e.unit_id = r.unit_id ), AcuteRFHemodialysis AS ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ep.patient_id) AS cnt FROM EligiblePatients ep JOIN treatment t ON ep.unit_id = t.unit_id WHERE t.treatment_name = 'hemodialysis - for acute renal failure' ), OtherHemodialysis AS ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ep.patient_id) AS cnt FROM EligiblePatients ep JOIN treatment t ON ep.unit_id = t.unit_id WHERE t.treatment_name LIKE '%hemodialysis%' AND t.treatment_name != 'hemodialysis - for acute renal failure' ) SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT cnt FROM AcuteRFHemodialysis) > 0 THEN (SELECT cnt FROM AcuteRFHemodialysis) WHEN (SELECT cnt FROM OtherHemodialysis) > 0 THEN (SELECT cnt FROM OtherHemodialysis) ELSE NULL END AS answer;

instruction: You are assisting with a clinical study evaluating anticoagulation prescribing patterns in ICU patients with atrial fibrillation or atrial flutter who have elevated thromboembolic risk. First, identify eligible patients who meet both of the following criteria during the same ICU admission: 1. Diagnosis of atrial fibrillation (including all variants such as paroxysmal, with rapid ventricular response, etc.) or atrial flutter 2. At least two of the following thromboembolic risk factors: - Age > 75 years - Stroke or TIA (transient ischemic attack) - Diabetes mellitus - Congestive heart failure Among the eligible patients, check if any have been prescribed apixaban recorded exactly as 'apixaban'. If so, report how many such patients exist. If no eligible patient has been prescribed apixaban, broaden the search to include any other anticoagulant therapy (such as warfarin, heparin, enoxaparin, or other anticoagulants), excluding apixaban, and report the count. If neither category yields results, report that no matching patients were found. Report the final count in words rather than numerals (e.g., 123 → one hundred and twenty-three).
gold_sql: WITH AFPatients AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ip.patient_id, ip.unit_id, ip.age FROM condition c JOIN icupatient ip ON c.unit_id = ip.unit_id WHERE c.condition_name LIKE '%atrial fibrillation%' OR c.condition_name LIKE '%atrial flutter%' ), EligiblePatients AS ( SELECT DISTINCT af.patient_id, af.unit_id FROM AFPatients af WHERE ( CASE WHEN af.age > 75 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM condition c WHERE c.unit_id = af.unit_id AND ( c.condition_name LIKE '%stroke%' OR c.condition_name = 'tia' OR c.condition_name LIKE '%transient ischemic%' ) ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM condition c WHERE c.unit_id = af.unit_id AND c.condition_name LIKE '%diabetes mellitus%' ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM condition c WHERE c.unit_id = af.unit_id AND c.condition_name LIKE '%congestive heart failure%' ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) >= 2 ), ApixabanPatients AS ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ep.patient_id) AS cnt FROM EligiblePatients ep JOIN prescription pr ON ep.unit_id = pr.unit_id WHERE pr.drug_name = 'apixaban' ), OtherAnticoagPatients AS ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ep.patient_id) AS cnt FROM EligiblePatients ep JOIN prescription pr ON ep.unit_id = pr.unit_id WHERE ( pr.drug_name LIKE '%warfarin%' OR pr.drug_name LIKE '%coumadin%' OR pr.drug_name LIKE '%heparin%' OR pr.drug_name LIKE '%enoxaparin%' OR pr.drug_name LIKE '%rivaroxaban%' OR pr.drug_name LIKE '%dabigatran%' OR pr.drug_name LIKE '%edoxaban%' ) AND pr.drug_name NOT LIKE '%apixaban%' ) SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT cnt FROM ApixabanPatients) > 0 THEN (SELECT cnt FROM ApixabanPatients) WHEN (SELECT cnt FROM OtherAnticoagPatients) > 0 THEN (SELECT cnt FROM OtherAnticoagPatients) ELSE NULL END AS answer;

instruction: Your goal is to explore statistics related to patient diagnoses. Specifically, you want to find the number of patients diagnosed with biliary obstruction in the emergency information table. The diagnosis should include the term 'biliary obstruction.' You want the number of patients reported in words instead of numerals (e.g., 123 patients → one hundred and twenty-three). If no dedicated emergency information table exists in the database, then repeat the question, but focus on patients diagnosed with biliary obstruction who were admitted to the emergency room.
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ip.patient_id) AS patient_count FROM icupatient ip JOIN condition c ON ip.unit_id = c.unit_id WHERE ip.hospital_admission_source = 'emergency department' AND c.condition_name LIKE '%biliary obstruction%';

instruction: Your goal is to explore statistics related to patient treatments. Specifically, you want to find the name of the most frequently used anticancer drug in the anticancer regimen table. If the anticancer regimen table exists in the database, you want to know the most frequently administered treatment name. If the anticancer regimen table does not exist in the database, you want to know the most frequently administered treatment containing the word "chemo." If multiple treatments occur with the same highest frequency, you want to know all of them. You want the answer to be the exact treatment name as recorded in the database.
gold_sql: SELECT treatment_name FROM ( SELECT treatment_name, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rank FROM treatment WHERE treatment_name LIKE '%chemo%' GROUP BY treatment_name ) AS ranked WHERE rank = 1;

instruction: Your goal is to explore cancer-related patient statistics. Specifically, you want to know the number of patients diagnosed with breast cancer in the outpatient information table. If the outpatient information table exists in the database, you want to know the number of patients with a diagnosis code indicating breast cancer. If the outpatient information table does not exist in the database, you want to know the number of breast cancer patients in other diagnosis-related table. You want the number of patients reported in words instead of numerals (e.g., 123 patients => one hundred and twenty-three).
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ip.patient_id) FROM icupatient ip JOIN condition c ON ip.unit_id = c.unit_id WHERE c.condition_name LIKE '%breast ca%';

instruction: Your goal is to explore statistics related to patient diagnoses. Specifically, you want to know the gender ratio of lung cancer patients in the cancer registry table. If the cancer registry table is available in the database, you want to know the gender ratio of patients with a cancer type of lung cancer. If the cancer registry table is not available in the database, you want to know the gender ratio of patients with a diagnosis of lung cancer. When asked about gender ratio calculations, you want to divide the number of male patients by the number of female patients and round the result to four decimal places. If a patient has one or more lung cancer records, even if cured, count them only once.
gold_sql: WITH lung_patients AS (SELECT DISTINCT i.patient_id, i.gender FROM CONDITION c JOIN icupatient i ON c.unit_id = i.unit_id WHERE c.condition_name LIKE '%lung ca%') SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN gender='male' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)*1.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN gender='female' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 4) AS gender_ratio FROM lung_patients;

instruction: You are studying opioid-related ED visits. Specifically, you first want to check for the existence of ed_toxicology, ed_screening, or uds (urine drug screen) tables. If found, count distinct patients with positive opioid results. If no such table exists, fall back to condition table diagnoses containing 'opioid', 'heroin', 'fentanyl', or 'overdose' among patients with emergency admission source. You want the number of patients reported in words instead of numerals (e.g., 123 patients => one hundred and twenty-three).
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ip.patient_id) AS patient_count FROM icupatient ip JOIN condition c ON ip.unit_id = c.unit_id WHERE ip.hospital_admission_source = 'emergency department' AND ( c.condition_name LIKE '%overdose%' OR c.condition_name LIKE '%opioid%' OR c.condition_name LIKE '%fentanyl%' OR c.condition_name LIKE '%heroin%' );
